Maya R.: FYI — noticed team in UK had PTO deducted on 12/26 but the observed holiday rolled to 12/27 this year. A few people ended up losing a PTO day. @people-ops? :grimacing:
Jordan (People Ops): Ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you drop the employee IDs here or DM me? Which office?
Maya R.: UK - small eng pod (5 ppl). Manager told them 12/26 was holiday but system used 12/27. I can paste the export.
Samir (Payroll): looping in payroll ops. We recently patched the holiday calendar normalization; looks like a DST/locale mapping edge case. We can reverse the deductions if we get manager approval and a list.
Jordan (People Ops): Cool — @Liam can you confirm approval to reverse PTO for the impacted people? We need attestation per audit.
Liam O'Neill (Manager): Confirmed. Approve reversals for the 5 affected. Sorry team — will communicate fix. :thumbsup:
Maya R.: list pasted from HRIS:
- eid:20001 Priya S. — PTO used 2026-12-27, observed holiday 2026-12-26
- eid:20002 Omar V. — PTO used 2026-12-27, observed holiday 2026-12-26
- eid:20003 Nia K. — PTO used 2026-12-27, observed holiday 2026-12-26
- eid:20004 Ben C. — PTO used 2026-12-27, observed holiday 2026-12-26
- eid:20005 Zoe H. — PTO used 2026-12-27, observed holiday 2026-12-26
Samir (Payroll): ETA: will queue rollback script today; changes will reflect on next payroll. Running rollback: python hr_tools/reconcile_holiday_mismatch.py --rollback --ids 20001,20002,20003,20004,20005 --region UK --note "observed-offset-2026"
Infra Bot: deploy payroll-fix succeeded at 2026-03-24T12:04:02Z
Samir (Payroll): Done — reversed duplicate PTO and updated balances. Also added detection rule HR_HOL_012 to detect observed-date mismatches when calendars are normalized.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks — I'll update the time-off doc and post a short manager FAQ about how to request reversals and approvers. Also opening incident HR-2026-189 for audit trail.
Maya R.: Confirmed balances look correct in portal. Thanks for quick turnaround. :relieved:
Liam O'Neill (Manager): Shoutout to payroll and ops for the fast fix.
Jordan (People Ops): Closing this thread. If anyone sees similar drift in other regions, please ping me directly.
